posts.title: List Poem: Winter Clothing
posts.description: Open the closet doorfor clothing long sinceout of sight and mind,a gathering of mentalpreparation:five scarves ofscattered, flowingsunset colors;four sets of gloveswith an extra twoabandoned lefties;three stitched hats,soft, with clickablefluorescent lights;two hand-warmersstill inside their plasticwrappings;one neon dog coatfor early winterwalking mornings For Open Write Peace (and poems),Kevin
